Package io.github.jspinak.brobot.logging

Class DiagnosticLogger

java.lang.Object
io.github.jspinak.brobot.logging.DiagnosticLogger
@Component public class DiagnosticLogger extends Object
Diagnostic logger for pattern matching and image analysis. Provides verbosity-aware logging that available at all verbosity levels.

In VERBOSE mode: Adds detailed information through BrobotLogger

In QUIET mode: Minimal output only
